originalVersionRule: A new-message update, received while connected after readyAt, with no edit date, posted strictly after readyAt and before receipt. This records an observed version, not a guarantee that no unobserved edit occurred.
availabilityRule: Use observedAt, never postedAt, as the earliest availability of this version. Exclude initial/final history snapshots from original-version eligibility. Retain edits, deletions, duplicates, and connection transitions.
persistence: One ordered append writer. Each event hashes its exact payload JSON and the preceding event hash. Only the target channel is persisted. No auth keys or environment contents are saved.
coverage: New/edit/delete update listeners, with one initial and one final 100-message history snapshot. Final snapshot reconciliation cannot prove completeness for deleted messages or more than 100 arrivals. This is data collection, with no paper or live trading decisions.
